recognize_zh: 低倍視野中幾乎全是單調的母細胞，許多核內有明顯淡染的杯狀凹陷，染色質細緻、胞質稀少，背景紅血球皺縮，符合伴杯狀母細胞的急性骨髓性白血病（高白血球）。
features: Monotonous sheet of medium-sized blasts replacing normal leukocytes
Fine chromatin with high N:C ratio
Scant pale basophilic cytoplasm; no Auer rods identified
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at lower magnification shows marked leukocytosis with a monotonous population of blasts and no evident maturing granulocytes. The blasts have fine chromatin, high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, and scant cytoplasm, and a large proportion exhibits cup-like nuclear invaginations. Red cells show crenation artifact. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia with cup-like blasts, suggestive of NPM1 and/or FLT3-ITD mutation; confirmation by flow cytometry and molecular studies is recommended.

ddx.vs: APL variant blasts have bilobed nuclei and faint granules with Auer rods and need PML::RARA exclusion rather than showing uniform nuclear cups.
ALL blasts are MPO negative and TdT positive without cup-like nuclear invaginations.

ddx.dx: Blast phase of chronic myeloid leukemia
ddx.vs: CML blast phase usually shows basophilia and residual myelocytes and is BCR::ABL1 positive.
